_note: General agronomy knowledge base for rule-based screening. Entries list POSSIBLE causes only; they are not confirmed diagnoses. Chemical names/doses are intentionally omitted - consult the local Agriculture Officer / KVK.

conditions.name: Nitrogen deficiency (possible)
next_steps: Get a soil test / Soil Health Card reading for nitrogen.
Check the fertilizer evaluation module before applying any nitrogen source.
prevention: Balanced fertilization based on soil test.
Include organic matter / crop rotation with legumes.

conditions.name: Phosphorus deficiency (possible)
next_steps: Soil test for available phosphorus and pH.
Compare with crop requirement in the fertilizer module.
prevention: Maintain soil pH in the crop's suitable range (P availability drops in very acidic/alkaline soil).

conditions.name: Potassium deficiency (possible)
next_steps: Rule out water stress and salinity first.
prevention: Soil-test based potash use; return crop residues where suitable.

conditions.name: Fungal leaf spot (possible)
next_steps: Remove and destroy badly affected leaves.
Upload a clear leaf photo to the image detector (supported crops only).
Consult the local Agriculture Officer / KVK for a confirmed diagnosis and approved treatment.
prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation and leaf wetness late in the day.
Use crop rotation and clean seed; keep field free of infected debris.

conditions.name: Powdery mildew (possible)
next_steps: Confirm with an extension officer before any treatment.
prevention: Improve air circulation and avoid excess nitrogen.

conditions.name: Viral disease or sucking-pest damage (possible)
next_steps: Check the underside of leaves for insects (whitefly, aphids, mites).
Remove and destroy severely affected plants to limit spread.
prevention: Use clean/certified seedlings and control weeds that host insects.

conditions.name: Water stress or root problem (possible)
next_steps: Check soil moisture at root depth and drainage.
Inspect roots/stem base for rot or insects.
